findings.location: REMAINING_RLGWOs/R0021.md:91 and :192; comments/33.md same sections; metadata/R0021.json nodes[id=R0021-COST].inputs/dependsOn
findings.contract: Original21-08.b and R0021-A01 require callback cost on final relevant integrated startup/L1 source; cold-review item6 requires exact hard interface dependencies.
findings.failureMode: COST depends only on HANDOFF. TIMING may subsequently repair a handed-off S1 miss, and L1-REPAIR changes the shared initial/preview/full display owner after intake. The graph has no produced final-source interface preventing a cost receipt on the earlier intake candidate from flowing to DELIVER with later changed source.
findings.counterexample: HANDOFF produces candidateH; COST measuresH; TIMING and/or L1-REPAIR later produceH2; QUALIFY usesH2; DELIVER sees COST+QUALIFY satisfied although the original final-source callback envelope was never measured onH2. The prose final-relevant-source entry condition is correct but not represented in inputs/dependencies.
findings.smallestCorrection: Add r0021-startup-timing/v1 and r0022-l1-source/v1 as exact pending consumed source/final-timing interfaces with hard dependencies on R0021-TIMING and R0022-L1-REPAIR, or consume an explicitly produced final-relevant-source manifest gate that covers both. Bind the cost result to that source and invalidate only affected cost after drift; no whole-issue closure dependency or extra benchmark programme.
findings.resolution: R0021-COST now consumes r0021-startup-timing/v1 and r0022-l1-source/v1 and has hard-interface predecessors R0021-TIMING and R0022-L1-REPAIR. Its entry requires both manifests reconciled onto one final combined candidate and affected timing reuse rebound or requalified before measurement. This prevents the original H-cost/H2-qualification counterexample.

findings.location: REMAINING_RLGWOs/R0025.md:126 R0025-A01; comments/37.md same row; metadata/R0025.json remainingObligations[id=25-07].acceptance[id=R0025-A01]
findings.contract: Every mandatory native negative/control must discriminate in the actual consumer; original same-time wind continuity and accepted old-velocity integration order are distinct invariants.
findings.failureMode: A01 requires a setter-before-old-velocity-advance mutant to fail with equal monotonic elapsed. Actual advanceCloudMotion returns before integration when elapsed<=0; swapping setter order at that fixture cannot alter accumulated position.
findings.counterexample: With _RAFNOW unchanged, elapsed=0 and the production guard returns at src/native/index.html:2503. Both healthy advance-before-setter and swapped setter-before-advance leave phase/life/wander unchanged; a failure would need a different input or an unrelated harness error.
findings.smallestCorrection: Keep accepted old-velocity ordering source/mutant evidence reused and make same-time native RED restore wind-times-epoch (the original failure mechanism), or specify a positive elapsed<=2s old/new velocity interval with exact prior velocity/expected accumulated phase and native pixel oracle. Do not claim the ordering mutant is detected by zero elapsed or rerun all accepted source controls.
evidence: REMAINING_RLGWOs/R0025.md R0025-A01 and D fault sequence
findings.resolution: Equal-time A01 now uses a wind-times-civil-epoch phase mutant and explicitly rejects zero elapsed as an ordering discriminator. New A06 sets simTime=18:10&timeScale=1, asserts FOLLOW_WALL_CLOCK=false and TIMESCALE=1, advances civil and monotonic clocks by500ms, and checks all three wrap(oldPhase-oldWx*oldWspd*0.5*(0.024+di*0.006),1.25) equations before installing replacement velocity, with native images and an independent old-velocity control. Inspected source confirms elapsed<=0/>2s suspension, rate handling, wrap1.25 and advance-before-setter. Unchanged accepted source-control receipt reuse is explicitly allowed.

findings.location: REMAINING_RLGWOs/R0021.md:174 R0021-S10 assertion; comments/33.md same cell; metadata/R0021.json remainingObligations[id=21-10].acceptance[id=R0021-S10].assertion
findings.contract: Bound CELESTIAL_STARTUP_RLGWO revision1/update2 S10 and R0022-L1 require owner acceptance of the corrected whole scene; strong left concentration and broad grey wash are explicitly rejected appearance targets, with legitimate physical fields preserved.
findings.failureMode: The assertion said Owner rejects neither strong left white concentration norbroadgreywash. That inverted sentence can be read as allowing the rejected appearance despite the correct whole-scene gates elsewhere.
findings.counterexample: An executor follows the isolated acceptance cell and retains the strong hotspot/wash as an accepted target while claiming the S10 row passed. The A/B objective and L1 owner decision reject that interpretation; the cell must have the same normative direction.
findings.smallestCorrection: Require owner acceptance of the matched unstripped complete scene under predeclared L1 display/preservation bounds and resolution of the previously rejected appearance, preserving the physical field without a total-removal requirement.
findings.resolution: The final spec/comment and metadata assertion now explicitly require Owner accepts the matched unstripped complete scene, including the left concentration and broad-wash regions, under the predeclared L1 display/preservation bounds; the previously rejected hotspot/wash appearance is no longer an unaccepted residual. It preserves the physical field without requiring total removal, and retains attribution/lunar-only metrics as insufficient for S10.
